title: Avalanche's Infinite Highway: Scaling to 1,000+ Custom Blockchains with John Nahas at KBW 2025
description:
KBW2026 tickets available now 🎟️  https://tickets.koreablockchainweek.com?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=kbw2026
Follow for more: https://linktr.ee/KBW2026 

John Nahas, Senior Vice President of Business Development at Ava Labs, takes the stage to discuss how the Avalanche network is evolving beyond the "first generation" business plan of single, general-purpose blockchains. In this presentation, John explains how Avalanche enables an "infinite highway" of purpose-built, application-specific layer 1 blockchains that are customizable, interoperable, and scalable to meet the needs of global enterprises and institutions

In this video:

- Moving beyond the limitations of general-purpose blockchains that share block space to a model of application-specific layer 1s that serve the business.
- How Avalanche L1s (formerly subnets) provide sovereign environments where network congestion or failures on other chains do not affect performance.
- Exploring the power of customization, allowing organizations to determine validator sets, jurisdictional compliance, and whether a chain is private, public-permissioned, or permissionless.
- Plans for a world with thousands of interconnected chains, illustrated by current use cases like SK Planet, Nexon’s MapleStory Universe, and a new K-pop loyalty blockchain called Titan.
- The role of Avalanche's sub-second finality and interoperability with the C-Chain to provide seamless asset movement across the entire ecosystem.

Timestamps:

00:00 - Introduction to Avalanche in Korea
01:12 - The Problem with Too Many General-Purpose Blockchains
03:18 - Legacy Scaling vs. the Avalanche Infinite Highway
05:40 - Scaling the Network: From Subnets to Layer 1s
07:56 - Customizable Chain Types: Private, Public, and Permissioned
09:15 - Interoperability with the C-Chain and Ecosystem Assets
12:08 - Sovereignty, Security, and Predictable Performance
13:35 - Cost-Effective Deployment via Ava Cloud
15:15 - Speed and Sub-Second Finality
16:17 - Real-World Applications: Banking, Sports, and K-Pop

Learn more about KBW2026 - https://koreablockchainweek.com/

About KBW (Korea Blockchain Week)

KBW is an annual global digital asset conference held in Seoul, South Korea, since 2018. It serves as a platform for leading blockchain companies, developers, investors, policymakers, and ecosystem stakeholders to engage in structured dialogue and knowledge exchange. Each year, KBW hosts a series of high-level programs and forums designed to facilitate global industry collaboration, advance technical and market understanding, and strengthen connections between the Korean market and the global digital asset ecosystem.

#kbw2025 #koreablockchainweek #seoul #korea #JohnNahas #Avalanche #AvaLabs
